methodology.summary: Static ownership audit of the complete legacy family schema using direct adapter/generator references plus explicit helper and layout-converter ownership, with behavioral overrides for independently confirmed gaps.
caveats: A geometry-driving or manufacturing-driving label means the setting is consumed by the current adapter/generator boundary; it is not a claim of full Cabinet Workshop parity.

Indirect recipe ownership is explicit: stock/thickness keys consumed through thicknessFromValues and section/mixed-bay keys consumed through sectionsFromWebValues are classified by their runtime owner rather than by direct-property syntax alone.
Compatibility-only covers legacy Output/System controls retained in familyValues while Standalone-native presentation/export commands remain authoritative.
Unsupported means no current adapter/generator behavior was found, or a behavioral audit confirmed metadata-only/no-op behavior.
Parity remains unverified unless a row is marked known-gap; representative fixtures provide independent evidence but do not verify every setting.
